shape.text: In the Atlas Administration API a database user's password is a write-only string of at least 8 characters, described as alphanumeric, and it does not appear in responses.
A database user's password is restricted to alphanumeric characters.

unresolved.reason: The field description says 'alphanumeric string' without stating whether other characters are rejected.

issuance.text: The password is supplied by the caller when the database user is created and is not generated by Atlas in a documented format.

collisions.text: A database user's password has no documented prefix or shape and is recognisable only in context, such as inside a connection string.

unresolved.reason: This follows from the absence of a documented shape; no page states it.

notes: Project-authored by the maintainers of this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Drafted from pages read 2026-10-04; nothing here asserts any product behaviour.
